title: Bridge footer
description: A sparse white footer: the stacked wordmark on the left, two narrow columns of plain links with the current page underlined, a wide gap, then small-print disclosure paragraphs bottom-left and two legal links bottom-right (split to the two edges on phones).
notes: the fine print paragraphs accept links (ReactNode)
link hover: text greys out over 0.25s
name: bridge-footer

props.name: brand
props.type: { name: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; tagline?: string | undefined; }
props.description: the wordmark: company name, small icon and parent-company tagline

props.name: columns
props.description: the link columns (two in the original)

props.name: finePrint
props.description: the small-print paragraphs; may hold links

props.name: legal
props.description: the two links at the bottom right
